summary: delete now prompts for confirmation before the live DELETE; --yes/--agent skip it, --no-input without --yes refuses.
reason: The generic delete command sent the live DELETE immediately with no confirmation, so a mistyped type/id could remove a Productive object irreversibly. The root command already exposes --yes for confirmation-safe scripting.
validated_outcome: Matrix tested: --dry-run previews without prompting; --no-input without --yes refuses; interactive 'n' aborts; --agent skips the prompt.
